Hücreyi çevreleyen sınır: neyin girip çı: The boundary around the cell. It chooses what goes in and out (selectively permeable).

Üstü ribozomlarla kaplı kanal sistemi: s: A channel system covered in ribosomes. It makes and carries proteins that will be secreted or sent to the membrane.
The rough ER sits right next to the nucleus. It sends its proteins to the Golgi in vesicles.
Ribozomsuz kanal sistemi: lipit sentezle: A channel system without ribosomes. It makes lipids and, in the liver, neutralizes harmful substances.
Granülsüz ER ribozom taşımaz. Kas hücres: The smooth ER has no ribosomes. In muscle cells it stores Ca²⁺.
ER'den gelen proteinleri düzenler, paket: Modifies and packages proteins from the ER and ships them in vesicles to where they are needed.
Golgi, üst üste dizili yassı keselerden: The Golgi is a shipping center made of flat sacs stacked on top of each other.
Hücrenin enerji santrali: oksijenli solu: The cell's power plant. It makes ATP from food through aerobic respiration.
Mitokondri çift zarlıdır, iç zarı kıvrım: A mitochondrion has two membranes, and the inner one is folded. It has its own DNA and ribosomes. Muscle cells have many.
Sindirim enzimleriyle dolu kesecik: hücr: A vesicle full of digestive enzymes. It digests material inside the cell and breaks down worn-out organelles.
Lizozom Golgi'den oluşur; özellikle hayv: Lysosomes form from the Golgi. They are found mainly in animal cells.
Zararlı hidrojen peroksiti (H₂O₂) katala: Uses the enzyme catalase to split harmful hydrogen peroxide (H₂O₂) into water and oxygen.
A peroxisome is a small vesicle with one membrane. Liver cells have many, and plant cells have them too.
Hücre bölünürken iğ ipliklerini düzenler: Organizes the spindle fibers during cell division. It is made of two small cylinders at right angles.
Sentrozom iki sentriolden oluşur. Hayvan: A centrosome is made of two centrioles. Animal cells have one, and plant cells do not.
Selülozdan yapılmış sağlam dış katman: h: A sturdy outer layer made of cellulose. It supports and protects the cell.
Hücre duvarı zarın dışındadır. Bitkide s: The cell wall is outside the membrane. In plants it is made of cellulose. Animal cells have none.
Klorofille ışık enerjisini yakalar, foto: Captures light energy with chlorophyll and makes glucose by photosynthesis.
Kloroplast çift zarlıdır ve kendi DNA'sı: A chloroplast has two membranes and its own DNA. It is a plastid found in plants and algae.
Su, besin, pigment ve atık depolayan kes: A sac that stores water, nutrients, pigments and waste. Filled with water, it keeps the plant cell firm.
Bitki hücresinde tek ve büyük bir merkez: A plant cell has one large central vacuole. Animal cells have small vacuoles.
